end.summary:
Discussed Diwali features: diyas, rangoli, lights, crackers, sweets, and new clothes.
Discussed harvest festivals and whether festival timing connects to farming seasons.
Kavya did not yet link harvest festivals with crops being ready.
Kavya named Makar Sankranti and til laddoos; Sweet Pongal details remained uncertain.
Teach-back was not passed; regional celebration description was incomplete.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying Diwali decorations, foods, and clothing, and introduced the link between harvest festivals and the season when crops are ready. Kavya shared several Diwali details and described rangoli, including a flower and tiger stencil; the mix-up that festival dates are random was not corrected by the end. At home, ask Kavya to sort festivals into “harvest time” or “other celebration” and explain why, using Makar Sankranti as one example.
